title: Queryable attributes for str-fts-compoundstructure-3 collection
description: This lists the attributes which can be filtered on and their types for str-fts-compoundstructure-3 collection.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

geometry_area_m2.description: The measured area of the geometry in square metres.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

name1_text.description: Name assigned to identify the feature.

name2_text.description: The alternative language name assigned to identify the feature.

name3_text.description: The proper name of a feature, populated where at least three or more names have been captured for the same feature.

name4_text.description: The proper name of a feature, populated where four names have been captured for the same feature.

status.description: The state of the feature in relation to either its physical condition or the activity the feature is intended to support.
